svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 1208 AI-attributed commits, 1247 AI actor presences across 100 active AI days (author dates), 2 AI providers. Daily collaboration 2026-05-19 to 2026-08-10, peak day 66 commits; bar height is total commits, fill is the day's AI share; publishable repositories only. Generated 2026-08-10.
